title: Rolling Jungle
description: A jungle track in E minor at 168 BPM, 64 bars (about 1 minute 31): a chopped break, a rolling sub bass, a dark pad and a short reese-like mono stab. The drums are a sample: a two-bar break loop from the Break Loops sample pack (a rendered loop, 168 BPM, stored in the state of the Loop Slicer), cut into 16 equal slices and re-sequenced by a Pattern Tracker with the patterns of the Loop Slicer Break Chops tunes. The song tempo equals the tempo of the break, so every slice plays at its own speed; swing is 0 because the groove is in the break. Intro, build, drop, break, second drop and outro. Checked on paper and with measurements only; not listened to.
